resources.notes: Proof-oriented treatment of vector spaces, linear maps, determinants, eigenvalues, inner products and canonical forms.

resources.title: Introduction to Probability and Statistics
resources.notes: Probability, Bayesian and frequentist inference, regression, simulation and statistical computing.

resources.title: Real Analysis
resources.notes: Rigorous analysis and proof construction covering limits, continuity, differentiation, integration and function sequences.

resources.title: arXiv Mathematics
resources.notes: Research/preprint layer; individual paper quality and license must be evaluated.

known_gaps: Foundation and beginner coverage remains thin for several taxonomy areas; university courses are not mapped downward merely to increase coverage.

Dedicated geometry, topology, number theory, discrete mathematics, complex analysis, differential equations, numerical analysis and optimization curricula should be added only after exact taxonomy-key verification.
Research repositories provide literature access but do not by themselves establish expert readiness without item-level review, retrieval verification, provenance and applied assessment.
